name: Rab Shakeh
overview: Rab Shakeh was an Assyrian officer sent by King Sennacherib to Jerusalem during the siege, as recorded in 2 Kings 18. He boldly addressed the leaders of Judah in their own language, seeking to undermine their trust in King Hezekiah and in God by questioning their confidence and urging them to surrender. His speech disparaged reliance on Egypt, likening it to a 'bruised reed,' and challenged the people's trust in the LORD, pointing to Hezekiah's reforms as reasons for doubt. This confrontation highlights the spiritual and political pressure faced by Jerusalem, emphasizing the tension between human alliances and faith in God's protection.
